<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template that matches the Doebner modification (formation of a C=C double bond, breaking a C-O and a C-C bond). We'll search the template catalog using these functional group criteria and then return the mapped reaction SMILES and the template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-O", "C-C"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 1
}</action_input>
